overall_goal: Heat a frying pan on the stove and coat it with olive oil.

goals.description: Place the pan on the stove and turn on the burner.
goals.rationale: The person transfers the frying pan to the hob and ignites the burner to begin heating it.

goals.description: Pour and spread oil in the pan.
goals.rationale: The person opens the oil bottle, pours oil into the pan, and tilts the pan to ensure an even coating before placing it back on the heat.
